thread:
sam: quick note—per-route dashboard is slow when 'model breakdown' is on. p95 ~2s on cold load.
nora: confirmed. we fire /route/summary then N /model/metrics. client waits for all before render.
devon: obvious fix: server-side aggregate endpoint that returns route + model slices. reduces RTTs.
keisha: product question: do we enable aggregated fetch by default for saved queries? concerned about telemetry quota hits.
sam: proposal: saved-query schema gets field prefetch=true/false/auto. auto = server decides based on org quota and recent usage.
nora: API sketch: GET /api/console/views/{id}?expand=prefetch&model_sample=0.15 -> returns meta:prefetch_applied,sample_rate,quota_state. client shows badge if sampled.
devon: ops note: emit meter tag console.view.telemetry with view_id so billing can attribute. also emit event when server downgrades to route-only.
keisha: UX copy draft: "Include per-model telemetry (may increase telemetry usage)." Tooltip: "We may fall back or sample if your org quota is limited." show estimate: "+~0.5s first load".
sam: console-bot perf run on staging: combined endpoint median 410ms vs 2.0s. p95 980ms vs 3.4s. test id: prefetch-2026-03-20.
ora: rollout plan: feature-flag endpoint -> client toggle persisted on saved views -> beta for opt-in orgs -> default off GA.
devon: i'll take API impl. keisha can own the saved-query schema change. billing-bot: please advise on meter tags.
billing-bot: ack. will add billing tag requirements and ensure downgrade events increment telemetry meter.
sam: filing umbrella issue with acceptance criteria: aggregate endpoint, saved-view prefetch flag, visible quota/cost hint, meter events for usage and downgrades, session caching heuristic. owners assigned.
console-bot: ci: console/prefetch-success build fc1234 passed.
keisha: thanks team, will follow up on copy and figma mock.
